Proof-of-history leader scheduling, hashing, tick and microblock publishing, and leader handoff logic.

# Purpose
This file implements the PoH tile for Firedancer. It manages the Proof of History state machine for a validator, including reset onto a new fork, leader detection, slot timing, tick production, microblock stamping, and leader handoff. It keeps the current hash chain, slot, tick count, and leader bank state, and it publishes PoH events to the shred tile, pack tile, and optional plugin links. It also tracks skipped slots by storing tick hashes so the next leader can replay them and keep the chain and slot data consistent.

The file also provides the external interface used by the Agave side of the system. Functions such as [`fd_ext_poh_initialize`](<#fd_ext_poh_initialize>), [`fd_ext_poh_reset`](<#fd_ext_poh_reset>), [`fd_ext_poh_begin_leader`](<#fd_ext_poh_begin_leader>), and [`fd_ext_poh_acquire_leader_bank`](<#fd_ext_poh_acquire_leader_bank>) let Rust code configure and control the tile. The code includes link helpers for mcache/dcache publication, key switch handling, bundle tip setup, feature activation forwarding, and metrics collection. At the end, it registers the tile as `fd_tile_poh` so the Firedancer tile runtime can create and run it.
